summary: @servicetitan/anvil-fonts 14.5.4 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: Version 14.5.4 of this fonts asset package ships a preinstall hook that runs automatically on `npm install`. The `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/`, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` against a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with obfuscator.io-style transforms: a rotated string/constant array (`n7gIxM=[...]` with a `WV8StW` rotator), mangled identifiers, and control-flow flattening, making the payload opaque to Node-based static analysis. The advertised purpose of the package is CSS/Less/SCSS delivery of Nunito Sans / Sofia font assets (`dist/css`, `dist/fonts`, `dist/less`, `dist/scss`); nothing in that purpose requires an alternate JavaScript runtime, network fetches, or executable code at install. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper, a large obfuscated sibling bundle executed via that runtime specifically to bypass Node-based scanners, doc/contents mismatch against the advertised fonts-only purpose, and automatic execution on preinstall is consistent with a compromised or malicious release of the `@servicetitan/anvil-fonts` name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
